authority: factory spec § 2.2 condition 7; successor Amendment 2026-10-03 (K1), megareview rulings (3) (ii) and (4); publication ruling D147 (a), 2026-10-03
note: One read of the discovery window, no p-value, a counted trial, never re-run. No request: the held chain store data/options.db (answers in data/raw/thetadata through rawFetch) and the held SPY daily closes. This file carries dates, digests and the clears flag; the statistic's value and its sigma are in the figures file at figures_path, which no bundle prefix reads. figures_sha256 = the sha256 of that file; script_sha256 = the sha256 of the script at script_path, committed before the read.
statistic: mean return per monthly cycle of the put credit spread, in σ-units per month
bar: zero on the registered sign (+): the row declares no baseline bar
